Support

How can we help?

Email us and a person replies within 2 business days.

Email support

brazosmvp@gmail.com

01

Cancel a job

Open the job in My Jobs and tap Cancel job. The app shows the fee, if any, before you confirm.

Cancelling is free more than 24 hours before the arrival window starts, within 15 minutes of hiring, or when the job has no scheduled date. After that, a cancellation fee may go to the Worker and the rest is refunded. The full rules are in the Terms of Service, section 4.

02

Report or block someone

In a conversation, open the menu and choose Report or Block. On a Worker's profile, tap Report this profile. Reports are reviewed by Brazos.

When you block someone, their posts, profile and reviews no longer appear to you, and they cannot message you or bid on your jobs.

03

Payments and refunds

Your payment is held until you approve the finished work. It is not insurance. If something is wrong, tap Report an issue on the job instead of approving: the payment stays held while Brazos reviews it.

Refunds go back to the card that paid, usually within 5 to 10 business days.

04

Delete your account

In the app: Profile → Account & safety → Delete account. You cannot delete it while a job or a payment is still in progress; the app lists what is outstanding.

What is deleted and what is kept is set out in the Privacy Policy, section 7. If you cannot get into the app, email us from the address on your account.

05

Safety

If you are in immediate danger, call 911. Brazos is not an emergency service. Brazos does not run background checks: take the same care you would with anyone you met outside the app.
